facts.statement: The dinosaur Bayannurosaurus was described in 2018 by the paleontologist Xu Xing.
facts.quote: Bayannurosaurus is a non-hadrosauriform ankylopollexian ornithopod described in 2018 by Xu Xing.

facts.statement: Bayannurosaurus lived during the early Aptian period in the Bayin-Gobi Formation of China.
facts.quote: It lived during the early Aptian period, being found in the Bayin-Gobi Formation of China.

facts.statement: Bayannurosaurus was a large iguanodontian that could reach a total body length of up to 9 meters.
facts.quote: It was a large iguanodontian, measuring up to 9 m in total body length.

facts.statement: A joint expedition exploring the Chulumiao locality in Bayannur, China, took place in the summer of 2013.
facts.quote: In the summer of 2013 a joint expedition of the Long Hao Institute of Geology and Paleontology and the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology explored the Chulumiao locality of Bayannur, China.

facts.statement: Bayannurosaurus is known only from a nearly complete, partially articulated holotype skeleton that preserves the entire tail.
facts.quote: Known only from the holotype IMMNH PV00001, Bayannurosaurus is represented by a nearly complete, partially articulated skeleton preserving all regions of anatomy including the entire tail.

facts.statement: Bayannurosaurus is classified as an intermediate form of Ankylopollexia, showing features transitional between earlier members and hadrosauriforms.
facts.quote: Bayannurosaurus shows a combination of features that place it as an intermediate form of Ankylopollexia, transitional between earlier members and hadrosauriforms.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that Bayannurosaurus and Lanzhousaurus resulted from allopatric speciation in Asia, separate from the immigration events linked to the origins of Hadrosauroidea.
facts.quote: Bayannurosaurus and Lanzhousaurus would be the result of allopatric speciation in Asia distinct from the later immigration to Asia around the origins of Hadrosauroidea.

facts.statement: Bayannurosaurus lived approximately 124 million years ago during the Berriasian stage of the early Cretaceous in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del periodo Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 124 millones de años, durante el Berriasiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Bayannurosaurus had a skull measuring 80 cm in length, classifying it as a medium-sized iguanodontian.
facts.quote: Su cráneo medía 80 cm de longitud, lo que le convierte en un iguanodontiano de tamaño mediano.

facts.statement: The time range for Bayannurosaurus is estimated to be between 121.4 and 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 119.57 million years ago)
